    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(r - (h-r-1)), "horizontal", r))
    for c in range(1, w - 1):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(c - (w-c-1)), "vertical", c))
    _, orientation, split = min(candidates)
    if orientation == "horizontal":
        a, b = grid[:split], grid[split+1:]
    else:
        a = [row[:split] for row in grid]
        b = [row[split+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0
